item.title: Annu Kapoor Birthday: From Selling Tea to Becoming a Bollywood Star
item.description: Famous Indian cinema and television actor, singer, director, radio jockey, and TV presenter Annu Kapoor was born on February 20, 1956, in Itwara, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. His real name is Anil Kapoor, but he is well-known in the film industry as Annu Kapoor. His father, Madanlal Kapoor, was Punjabi and ran a Parsi theatre company, while his mother, Kamal, was Bengali and a poetess as well as a trained classical singer.
